name: Post-Meal Walk
title: Walk after one meal per day.
subtitle: Meal Protocol
rationale: Walking soon after eating blunts the glucose spike that produces the post-meal energy crash.
tierTarget: A walk after at least 1 meal

evidence.summary: Walking soon after eating reduces acute post-meal glucose excursions.

indications: Focus reliably dips in the hour after lunch.
Post-meal glucose spikes or sluggishness are suspected or measured.
Days include at least one meal followed immediately by desk work.
